reason: Those settlement emails already look like spam to me, so I am not making an account on a beta site I found on Google just to click through to a form I still have to file myself. Free now with a paid model later is exactly the catch I assume is coming.
objection: If it's free during beta, what's the catch later? I already treat this stuff like spam.
would_change_my_mind: If I googled one settlement I already knew was real and this sent me straight to the official form with no account and a written promise they will never charge me.
